messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: scanone/scantwo perm.strata problem
parts:
(I got the following email and thought I should post it, with the author's permission.)

Question about batch permutations of phenotypes using "perm.strata".

When I run a single trait using this approach, there is no problem. The machinery removes NAs from both the phenotype and the perm.strata vector. Both the cross and the perm.strata vector are culled from 241 individuals to 238 and the perms proceed without a problem. 

However, when I batch the phenotypes together, I get an error. It seems that NAs are removed from the phenotype, but not from the perm.strata vector, resulting in different lengths of the arguments, returning an error. 

Do you have a work around for this problem? If not, of course I can loop through the phenotypes, but this is significantly slower, especially with scantwo.

> s1.perms.cov<-scanone(cross, pheno.col=allphes[1], method="hk",n.perm=10, addcovar=mycovar, perm.strata=mystrat)
Permutation 1 
Permutation 2 
Permutation 3 
Permutation 4 
Permutation 5 
Permutation 6 
Permutation 7 
Permutation 8 
Permutation 9 
Permutation 10 
> 
> summary(s1.perms.cov)
LOD thresholds (10 permutations)
     lod
5%  1.69
10% 1.64
> s1.perms.cov<-scanone(cross, pheno.col=allphes, method="hk",n.perm=10, addcovar=mycovar, perm.strata=mystrat)
Permutation 1 
Error in scanone(subset(cross, ind = upat[[i]]), chr = chr, pheno.col = batches[[i]],  : 

  perm.strata, if given, must have length = nind(cross) [338]

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: scanone/scantwo perm.strata problem
parts:
I was able to fix this bug.

It'll be some time before I can release a new version to CRAN, though. There are some pesky memory leaks that they want me to fix before taking a new version.

If you have the necessary compilers (particularly for fortran), you can use devtools::install_github to install the devel version:

    install.packages("devtools")
    library(devtools)
    install_github("kbroman/qtl", ref="devel")

karl

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: scanone/scantwo perm.strata problem
parts:
You can get around devtools, but not the fortran compiler.

But the version of R/qtl on CRAN is from 2015-03-06, so this bug should be fixed there.

karl
